'''''Tritonia gladiolaris''''' is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the genus ''[[Tritonia (plant)|Tritonia]]''.<ref>[http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=1537-76 Pencilled Tritonia] in SANBI Red List of South African Plants</ref> The plant is native to [[KwaZulu-Natal]], [[Lesotho]], [[Mpumalanga]], the [[Eastern Cape]] and the [[Western Cape]].<ref>[http://plantsoftheworldonline.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:77079440-1 ''Tritonia gladiolaris''] in Plants of the World Online</ref>
